from pathlib import Path

print("Using sheet:", ws.title)

# Find real last non-empty row/column by scanning all cells
real_max_row = 0
real_max_col = 0
for row in ws.iter_rows():

            real_max_col = max(real_max_col, cell.column)

# Print all populated cells in the relevant visible data area for inspection

# Inspect other sheets for possible helper/reference content
for sname in wb.sheetnames:

    print(f"Other sheet {sname} non-empty cells:", other_nonempty[:20], "count:", len(other_nonempty))

# --------------------

min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(answer_range)

    for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1):

print("Non-empty cells in Column B after save:", nonempty_b)
